registered_allowance_formulas.J: At each J center, A_J = 3*abs(r_RC1)*abs(T_U,h=.05 at that fixed P,J) + abs(D_b,J(h=.10)-D_b,J(h=.05)); the J target T_J is fixed-P production dE_Hub/dJ.
registered_allowance_formulas.U: A_U = 3*abs(r_RC1)*abs(T_U,h=.05) + abs(D_b,U(h=.10)-D_b,U(h=.05)); T_U is fixed-P production dE_Hub/dU at U=2,J=0; D_b,U is the local-b total candidate finite-difference slope.
registered_allowance_formulas.gate: At both h=.05 and h=.10, candidate b must lie within A of the fixed-P target, and candidate c must miss the fixed-P target by more than 10*A. Candidate a is RECORD only.
registered_allowance_formulas.units: Ry/eV; use absolute slope-difference spread, derived from signed slopes.

campaign_scheduler.early_freeze: SIGSTOP after first contiguous accepted 20-step P_OUT window and matching ordered Diff marker; copy frozen Fe_scf/DOS/report and full trace; SIGTERM only owned solver
campaign_scheduler.endpoint_verification: Every C1-accepted terminal checkpoint must have saved Fe_scf/Fe_out d occupations and |all-shell spin difference| inside the final-20 P_OUT ranges; stores exact path/hash.
campaign_scheduler.gate: Requires finite numeric RC1 residual evidence with max absolute value <=0.01. An RC1 status of UNESTABLISHED_PROVISIONAL_RECORD is permitted by C1 §1.3 and C3 because C3 stops only on numeric residual >1%; provenance preserves that RC1 is not a gate PASS.
